scope: Acceptance of the explained evidence criterion for question 7. The RDF representation remains a separate review item.

accepted.meaning: An independently verified complete intervening history is sufficient to establish that movements belong to one person's continuous runner trajectory. A separate explicit source statement linking the movements is not required when that standard is met.
requiredEvidence: The same person throughout the proposed continuous trajectory
Independently verified complete coverage of the intervening history, with events accounted for
No intervening replacement, out, score or inning ending that breaks the proposed continuity
insufficientEvidence: Absence of a movement row without independently established coverage
accepted.contributionBoundary: One personal trajectory retains separate batter-attributed and independent contribution episodes. In the single, steal, teammate-single example, the steal belongs to the runner and the teammate's single receives only second-to-third credit.
accepted.replacementBoundary: Replacement ends the original person's trajectory and starts a different person's trajectory.
accepted.missingEvidenceBehavior: Keep dependent metrics unavailable when the required coverage or continuity evidence cannot be established.

remainingReview: Authoritative RDF representation and executable graph contract for this evidence
Source reconciliation demonstrating that actual histories satisfy the accepted standard
unchanged: No new object properties, including index predicates
No new ontology terms, RDF minting rules or semantic fingerprint approval
No assumption that existing source records or promoted graphs already meet the accepted standard
Existing personal trajectory lifetime and separate contribution attribution
